Dataset-level version of `Fig4.PartII-compare-conditions.Rmd`. Each dataset is loaded
separately: YPD.1, YPD.2, sc2glu.1, sc2glu.2 (replicates of two baseline conditions),
Flu.1 = fluconazole 16 ug/ml and Flu.2 = fluconazole 8 ug/ml (two doses, not replicates, so
they are never merged), scgal.1 (SC + galactose), plus the integrated sc2glu.1 + sc2glu.2 dataset. sc2glu.1 on its own
(46 strains, 1,637 cells) is small: its tables are written to
`../results/replicates/sc2glu.1_data/` (Section 11), and it is drawn only in the
"All six datasets", "All seven datasets" and "Integrated and replicates" sets. The integrated sc2glu dataset (which includes sc2glu.1) is kept. The
eQTL-count, expression-variance and effect-size figures are drawn for these sets:

| Set | Datasets |
|---|---|
| All datasets | YPD.1, YPD.2, sc2glu.2, Flu.1 (16 ug/ml), Flu.2 (8 ug/ml) |
| Datasets .2 | YPD.2, sc2glu.2, Flu.2 (8 ug/ml) |
| YPD.1, sc2glu.2, both doses | YPD.1, sc2glu.2, Flu.1, Flu.2 |
| Integrated sc2glu | YPD.1, sc2glu (integrated), Flu.1, Flu.2 |
| YPD.1, YPD.2, integrated sc2glu, both doses | YPD.1, YPD.2, sc2glu (integrated), Flu.1, Flu.2 |
| Integrated YPD, integrated sc2glu, both doses | YPD (integrated), sc2glu (integrated), Flu.1, Flu.2 |
| All six datasets | YPD.1, YPD.2, sc2glu.1, sc2glu.2, Flu.1, Flu.2 |
| All seven datasets | YPD.1, YPD.2, sc2glu.1, sc2glu.2, Flu.1, Flu.2, scgal.1 (galactose) |
| YPD.1, YPD.2, sc2glu.2, both doses, galactose | YPD.1, YPD.2, sc2glu.2, Flu.1, Flu.2, scgal.1 (galactose) |
| Integrated and replicates | YPD.1, YPD.2, YPD (integrated), sc2glu.1, sc2glu.2, sc2glu (integrated), Flu.1, Flu.2, scgal.1 (galactose) |

Sections 6-10 (overlap, sharing, concordance, GO, dose-specific eQTLs) compare each
fluconazole dose with three baselines, named in every figure: YPD.1, YPD (integrated
YPD.1 + YPD.2) and SC2Glu (integrated sc2glu.1 + sc2glu.2).

```{r libs}
# title, grey strips with black border, no minor or vertical grid. theme_minimal for
# violins/densities, theme_classic for bars and scatter (as in Figure.3).
AXIS_SIZE <- 16
pub_theme <- function(base = theme_minimal, base_size = 14) {
  base(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(plot.title    = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey40"),
          axis.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = AXIS_SIZE, color = "black"),
          axis.text     = element_text(face = "bold", size = AXIS_SIZE, color = "black"),
          strip.text    = element_text(size = AXIS_SIZE, face = "bold"),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "black"),
          legend.title  = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
          legend.text   = element_text(color = "black"),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}
```

# 1. Conditions, sets and inputs

Per condition: the gene matrix that went into FastLMM (phenotype/strain counts, variance)
and the annotated clumped eQTL tables written by the Step1 classification Rmd
(Figure.3 for YPD.1, Figure.4 for the others).

```{r config}
ROOT <- "/projects/rps/cgsb/gresham/Akriti/wildyeast1/common_analysis_for_all"
F3   <- file.path(ROOT, "Agrawal_single_cell_eqtl_cell_cycle/Figure.3/Fig.3-Panel-A-C-D-cis-and-trans-eqtl-YPD-variant-type/results/YPD.1")
F4   <- file.path(ROOT, "Agrawal_single_cell_eqtl_cell_cycle/Figure.4")

annot_dir <- function(d) file.path(F4, paste0("Fig.4-", d), "results", d, "annotations")

COND <- tribble(
  ~key,                ~label,                ~gene_matrix,                                                          ~annot,
  "YPD.1",             "YPD.1",               "YPD.1/fastlmm/data/pheno_data/gene_matrix.txt",                       file.path(F3, "annotations"),
  "YPD.2",             "YPD.2",               "YPD.2/fastlmm/data/pheno_data/gene_matrix.txt",                       annot_dir("YPD.2"),
  "sc2glu.1",          "synthetic complete with glucose.1", "sc2glu.1/fastlmm_sc2.glu.1_only/data/pheno_data/gene_matrix.txt",     annot_dir("sc2glu.1_only"),
  "sc2glu.2",          "synthetic complete with glucose",   "sc2glu.2/fastlmm_sc2.glu.2_only/data/pheno_data/gene_matrix.txt",     annot_dir("sc2glu.2_only"),
  "Flu.1",             "fluconazole.16",      "Flu.1/fastlmm/data/pheno_data/gene_matrix.txt",                       annot_dir("Flu.1"),
  "Flu.2",             "fluconazole.8",       "Flu.2/fastlmm/data/pheno_data/gene_matrix.txt",                       annot_dir("Flu.2"),
  "scgal.1",           "synthetic complete with galactose",           "scgal.1/fastlmm/data/pheno_data/gene_matrix.txt",                     annot_dir("scgal.1"),
  "sc2glu_integrated", "SC2Glu (integrated)", "sc2glu.2/fastlmm/data/pheno_data/gene_matrix.txt",                    annot_dir("sc2glu_integrated"),
  "YPD_integrated",    "YPD (integrated)",    "merged_YPD/fastlmm/data/pheno_data/gene_matrix.txt",                  annot_dir("YPD_integrated")
) %>% mutate(gene_matrix = file.path(ROOT, gene_matrix))

# colours: green = YPD, red = synthetic complete (.1 dark brick red, .2 red; integrated orange),
# purple = fluconazole (16 ug/ml light, 8 ug/ml dark), golden yellow = galactose (pure yellow is
# invisible on white)
cond_colors <- c("YPD.1" = "#81C784", "YPD.2" = "#2E7D32",
                 "YPD (integrated)" = "#1565C0",
                 "synthetic complete with glucose.1" = "#8B1A1A", "synthetic complete with glucose" = "#E53935", "synthetic complete with glucose.2" = "#E53935", "SC2Glu (integrated)" = "#FF9800",
                 "fluconazole.16" = "#BA68C8", "fluconazole.8" = "#6A1B9A",
                 "synthetic complete with galactose" = "#F9C80E")

SETS <- list(
  # sc2glu.1 (46 strains) is drawn only in "All six/seven datasets" and "Integrated and replicates"
  "All datasets"                = c("YPD.1", "YPD.2", "sc2glu.2", "Flu.1", "Flu.2"),
  "Datasets .2"                 = c("YPD.2", "sc2glu.2", "Flu.2"),
  "YPD.1, sc2glu.2, both doses" = c("YPD.1", "sc2glu.2", "Flu.1", "Flu.2"),
  "Integrated sc2glu"           = c("YPD.1", "sc2glu_integrated", "Flu.1", "Flu.2"),
  "YPD.1, YPD.2, integrated sc2glu, both doses" = c("YPD.1", "YPD.2", "sc2glu_integrated", "Flu.1", "Flu.2"),
  "Integrated YPD, integrated sc2glu, both doses" = c("YPD_integrated", "sc2glu_integrated", "Flu.1", "Flu.2"),
  "All six datasets"            = c("YPD.1", "YPD.2", "sc2glu.1", "sc2glu.2", "Flu.1", "Flu.2"),
  "All seven datasets"          = c("YPD.1", "YPD.2", "sc2glu.1", "sc2glu.2", "Flu.1", "Flu.2", "scgal.1"),
  "YPD.1, YPD.2, sc2glu.2, both doses, galactose" = c("YPD.1", "YPD.2", "sc2glu.2", "Flu.1", "Flu.2", "scgal.1"),
  "Integrated and replicates"   = c("YPD.1", "YPD.2", "YPD_integrated", "sc2glu.1", "sc2glu.2", "sc2glu_integrated",
                                    "Flu.1", "Flu.2", "scgal.1"))
set_file <- function(s) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", s)
lab_of   <- setNames(COND$label, COND$key)
# labels within one set: sc2glu.2 is "synthetic complete with glucose.2" when sc2glu.1 is in the same set,
# otherwise plain "synthetic complete with glucose"
set_lab  <- function(keys) {
  l <- lab_of[keys]
  if (all(c("sc2glu.1", "sc2glu.2") %in% keys)) l[["sc2glu.2"]] <- "synthetic complete with glucose.2"
  l
}
# long condition names ("synthetic complete with galactose") wrap onto two lines on discrete x axes;
# ggplot2 picks up this default x scale from the global environment
scale_x_discrete <- function(..., labels = function(x) stringr::str_wrap(x, 20)) ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(..., labels = labels)

annot_files <- c(SNPs = "snp_data_annotated_cis_trans.txt", CNVs = "cnv_data_annotated_cis_trans.txt",
                 InDels = "indel_data_annotated_cis_trans.txt", SVs = "sv_data_annotated_cis_trans.txt")
missing <- c(COND$gene_matrix, as.vector(outer(COND$annot, annot_files, file.path)))
missing <- missing[!file.exists(missing)]
if (length(missing)) stop("Missing inputs:\n", paste(missing, collapse = "\n"))
print(COND %>% select(key, label))
```

```{r load}
gene_matrices <- setNames(lapply(COND$gene_matrix, function(p)
  read.table(p, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)), COND$key)

read_annot <- function(dir) {
  bind_rows(lapply(names(annot_files), function(vt)
    fread(file.path(dir, annot_files[[vt]]), sep = "\t", data.table = FALSE) %>%
      select(any_of(c("SNP", "Pheno", "SnpWeight", "EffectSize", "PValue", "cis_trans", "local_distant", "Location",
                      "Variant_Chr", "ChrPos", "Causal_Gene", "Variant_subtype"))) %>%
      mutate(Genetic_variants = vt)))
}
clumped <- setNames(lapply(COND$annot, read_annot), COND$key)
for (k in COND$key) clumped[[k]]$condition <- lab_of[[k]]

sapply(clumped, nrow)
```

# 2. Between-strain expression variance (power QC)

eQTL detection depends on a gene's expression varying across strains; a condition with
lower between-strain variance has less to map on. For each set, genes and strains shared
by all of its conditions are used, per-gene variance across strains is compared
(density plot; pairwise paired Wilcoxon printed).

```{r var-fns}
# first column = gene ID
to_mat <- function(gm) { m <- as.matrix(gm[, -1, drop = FALSE]); rownames(m) <- gm[[1]]; m }
mats <- lapply(gene_matrices, to_mat)
for (k in names(mats)) cat(sprintf("%-20s %5d genes x %3d strains\n", lab_of[[k]], nrow(mats[[k]]), ncol(mats[[k]])))

var_across <- function(mat, genes, strains) apply(mat[genes, strains, drop = FALSE], 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)

variance_set <- function(keys) {
  g <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(mats[keys], rownames))
  s <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(mats[keys], colnames))
  v <- as.data.frame(sapply(keys, function(k) var_across(mats[[k]], g, s)))
  names(v) <- set_lab(keys)
  list(genes = g, strains = s, wide = v,
       long = v %>% mutate(gene = g) %>%
         pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "condition", values_to = "variance") %>%
         mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = set_lab(keys))) %>%
         filter(!is.na(variance)))
}

plot_variance_density <- function(vs, set_name) {
  med <- vs$long %>% group_by(condition) %>%
    summarise(median_val = median(variance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(median_log = log2(median_val + 1))
  leg <- setNames(paste0(med$condition, " (median ", round(med$median_val, 1), ")"), med$condition)
  ggplot(vs$long, aes(log2(variance + 1), fill = condition, color = condition)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.3, linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(data = med, aes(xintercept = median_log, color = condition),
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cond_colors, labels = leg) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cond_colors, labels = leg) +
    labs(title = "Gene expression variance across strains",
         subtitle = paste0(set_name, " | shared ", length(vs$genes), " genes x ", length(vs$strains), " strains"),
         x = "log2(variance + 1)", y = "Density", fill = "Condition", color = "Condition") +
    pub_theme()
}
```

```{r var-density, fig.width=9, fig.height=5.5, results='asis'}
var_sets <- lapply(SETS, variance_set)
for (s in names(SETS)) {
  cat("\n\n### ", s, "\n\n", sep = "")
  vs <- var_sets[[s]]
  cat("Median variance:", paste(sprintf("%s = %.2f", names(vs$wide), apply(vs$wide, 2, median, na.rm = TRUE)),
                                collapse = "; "), "\n\n")
  pw <- combn(names(vs$wide), 2, simplify = FALSE)
  cat("Paired Wilcoxon (two-sided):", paste(sapply(pw, function(p)
    sprintf("%s vs %s p = %s", p[1], p[2],
            format(wilcox.test(vs$wide[[p[1]]], vs$wide[[p[2]]], paired = TRUE)$p.value, digits = 3))),
    collapse = "; "), "\n\n")
  p <- plot_variance_density(vs, s)
  print(p)
  ggsave(file.path(OUT, paste0("figV1_variance_density_", set_file(s), ".tiff")), p,
         width = 9, height = 5.5, dpi = 600, units = "in", device = "tiff", compression = "lzw")
}
```

# 3. Combine

```{r combine}
# location = local / distant (per-gene clumps, 25 kb; Step1 column local_distant)
get_location <- function(df) df$local_distant
signed_col   <- "SnpWeight"

combined_all <- bind_rows(clumped)
combined_all$CT       <- get_location(combined_all)
combined_all$abs_beta <- abs(combined_all[[signed_col]])

combined_for <- function(keys) combined_all %>%
  filter(condition %in% lab_of[keys]) %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(unname(set_lab(keys)[match(condition, lab_of[keys])]), levels = set_lab(keys)))
```

# 4. eQTL detection and experimental scale

Absolute eQTL counts track strain number and between-strain variance (Section 2), so they
are descriptive. One panel per condition set.

```{r scale-fns}
pheno_strain_summary <- data.frame(
  key          = COND$key,
  condition    = COND$label,
  n_phenotypes = sapply(gene_matrices[COND$key], nrow),
  n_strains    = sapply(gene_matrices[COND$key], ncol) - 1,
  n_eQTLs      = sapply(clumped[COND$key], nrow))
print(pheno_strain_summary, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(pheno_strain_summary, file.path(OUT, "condition_scale_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

plot_eqtl_detection <- function(keys, set_name) {
  d <- pheno_strain_summary %>% filter(key %in% keys) %>%
    mutate(condition = factor(set_lab(keys)[key], levels = set_lab(keys)))
  ggplot(d, aes(condition, n_eQTLs, fill = condition)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6) +
    geom_text(aes(label = n_eQTLs), vjust = -0.4, size = 4.8, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
    # white box behind the black text so it stays readable on dark bar fills
    geom_label(aes(y = 0, label = paste0(n_strains, " strains")), vjust = -0.4, size = 3.6, color = "black",
               fill = alpha("white", 0.85), label.size = 0, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cond_colors) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of eQTLs detected") +
    pub_theme(theme_classic) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
}

plot_scale <- function(keys, set_name) {
  pheno_strain_summary %>% filter(key %in% keys) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(n_phenotypes, n_strains, n_eQTLs), names_to = "metric", values_to = "count") %>%
    mutate(condition = factor(set_lab(keys)[key], levels = set_lab(keys)),
           metric = factor(metric, levels = c("n_phenotypes", "n_strains", "n_eQTLs"),
                           labels = c("Phenotypes (genes)", "Strains", "eQTLs detected"))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(metric, count, fill = condition)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.75) +
    geom_text(aes(label = count), position = position_dodge(0.75), vjust = -0.4, size = 2.8, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cond_colors) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Count", fill = "Condition",
         title = "Experimental scale and eQTL detection", subtitle = set_name) +
    pub_theme(theme_classic) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
}

plot_typecount <- function(keys, set_name) {
  combined_for(keys) %>% count(condition, Genetic_variants) %>%
    mutate(Genetic_variants = factor(Genetic_variants, levels = variant_levels)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(Genetic_variants, n, fill = condition)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.85), width = 0.8, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.15) +
    geom_text(aes(label = n), position = position_dodge(width = 0.85), vjust = -0.3, size = 2.5, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cond_colors, name = "Condition") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
    labs(x = "Variant type", y = "Number of eQTLs", title = "eQTL counts by variant type", subtitle = set_name) +
    pub_theme(theme_classic) +
    theme(legend.position = "top", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2))
}
```

```{r scale, fig.width=8, fig.height=4.5, results='asis'}
for (s in names(SETS)) {
  cat("\n\n### ", s, "\n\n", sep = "")
  p1 <- plot_eqtl_detection(SETS[[s]], s); print(p1)
  ggsave(file.path(OUT, paste0("fig_eqtl_detection_", set_file(s), ".tiff")), p1,
         width = 1.2 * length(SETS[[s]]) + 2.5, height = 4.5, dpi = 600, units = "in", device = "tiff", compression = "lzw")
  p2 <- plot_scale(SETS[[s]], s); print(p2)
  ggsave(file.path(OUT, paste0("figS_scale_eqtl_detection_", set_file(s), ".tiff")), p2,
         width = 8, height = 4.5, dpi = 600, units = "in", device = "tiff", compression = "lzw")
  p3 <- plot_typecount(SETS[[s]], s); print(p3)
  ggsave(file.path(OUT, paste0("figS_eqtl_count_by_variant_type_", set_file(s), ".tiff")), p3,
         width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 600, units = "in", device = "tiff", compression = "lzw")
}
```

# 5. Effect size by variant type and location

Per set: (a) variant type x location with conditions side by side (Kruskal-Wallis across
conditions per cell), (b) variant type only, (c) location only (Mann-Whitney local vs distant
per condition), (d) condition only (Kruskal-Wallis + pairwise Wilcoxon).

```{r effect-size-fns}
dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.85)
es_theme <- pub_theme() +
  theme(legend.position = "top", plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 15, b = 25, l = 10))

es_data <- function(keys) combined_for(keys) %>%
  filter(CT %in% c("Local", "Distant"), !is.na(abs_beta)) %>%
  mutate(Genetic_variants = factor(Genetic_variants, levels = variant_levels),
         CT = factor(CT, levels = c("Local", "Distant")))

plot_es_type_location <- function(es, set_name) {
  n_lab <- es %>% count(Genetic_variants, CT, condition, name = "n")
  p_lab <- es %>% group_by(Genetic_variants, CT) %>%
    summarise(p = {
      ok <- table(droplevels(condition))
      if (sum(ok >= 3) >= 2) tryCatch(format.pval(kruskal.test(abs_beta ~ condition)$p.value, digits = 2),
                                      error = function(e) NA_character_) else NA_character_
    }, .groups = "drop") %>% filter(!is.na(p)) %>% mutate(label = paste0("KW p = ", p))
  ggplot(es, aes(CT, abs_beta, fill = condition)) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6, scale = "width", position = dodge, width = 0.8, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(group = interaction(CT, condition)), width = 0.1, fill = "white",
                 outlier.shape = NA, position = dodge, linewidth = 0.3, coef = 0) +
    facet_grid(. ~ Genetic_variants) +
    geom_text(data = p_lab, aes(x = as.integer(CT), y = Inf, label = label),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = 1.4, size = 2.7) +
    geom_text(data = n_lab, aes(x = CT, y = 0, label = n, color = condition, group = condition),
              position = dodge, angle = 90, hjust = -0.15, size = 2.2, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cond_colors, name = "Condition") +
    scale_color_manual(values = cond_colors, guide = "none") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max(es$abs_beta, 0.98, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.15), clip = "off") +
    labs(x = "Variant location", y = BETA_LAB,
         title = "Effect size by variant type and location", subtitle = set_name) +
    es_theme
}

plot_es_type <- function(es, set_name) {
  n_lab <- es %>% count(Genetic_variants, condition, name = "n")
  p_lab <- es %>% group_by(condition) %>%
    summarise(p = if (n_distinct(Genetic_variants) >= 2)
      tryCatch(format.pval(kruskal.test(abs_beta ~ Genetic_variants)$p.value, digits = 2),
               error = function(e) NA_character_) else NA_character_, .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(!is.na(p)) %>%
    mutate(label = paste0(condition, ": KW p = ", p), vj = 1.4 + 1.3 * (row_number() - 1))
  ord <- es %>% group_by(Genetic_variants) %>% summarise(m = median(abs_beta), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(m)) %>% pull(Genetic_variants) %>% as.character()
  es <- es %>% mutate(Genetic_variants = factor(Genetic_variants, levels = ord))
  n_lab <- n_lab %>% mutate(Genetic_variants = factor(Genetic_variants, levels = ord))
  ggplot(es, aes(Genetic_variants, abs_beta, fill = condition)) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6, scale = "width", position = dodge, width = 0.8, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(group = interaction(Genetic_variants, condition)), width = 0.1, fill = "white",
                 outlier.shape = NA, position = dodge, linewidth = 0.3, coef = 0) +
    geom_text(data = p_lab, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = label, color = condition, vjust = vj),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 1.05, size = 2.6, fontface = "bold") +
    geom_text(data = n_lab, aes(x = Genetic_variants, y = 0, label = n, color = condition, group = condition),
              position = dodge, angle = 90, hjust = -0.15, size = 2.2, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cond_colors, name = "Condition") +
    scale_color_manual(values = cond_colors, guide = "none") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max(es$abs_beta, 0.98, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.25), clip = "off") +
    labs(x = "Variant type", y = BETA_LAB,
         title = "Effect size by variant type (local + distant pooled)", subtitle = set_name) +
    es_theme
}

plot_es_location <- function(es, set_name) {
  n_lab <- es %>% count(CT, condition, name = "n")
  max_y <- max(es$abs_beta, 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)
  p_lab <- es %>% group_by(condition) %>%
    summarise(p = if (n_distinct(CT) == 2 && all(table(CT) >= 3))
      tryCatch(format.pval(wilcox.test(abs_beta ~ CT)$p.value, digits = 2), error = function(e) NA_character_)
      else NA_character_, .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(!is.na(p)) %>%
    mutate(label = paste0("MW p = ", p), y_bracket = max_y * (1.0 + 0.06 * (n() - row_number())))
  ggplot(es, aes(CT, abs_beta, fill = condition)) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6, scale = "width", position = dodge, width = 0.8, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(group = interaction(CT, condition)), width = 0.1, fill = "white",
                 outlier.shape = NA, position = dodge, linewidth = 0.3, coef = 0) +
    geom_segment(data = p_lab, aes(x = 0.8, xend = 2.2, y = y_bracket, yend = y_bracket, color = condition),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text(data = p_lab, aes(x = 1.5, y = y_bracket, label = label, color = condition),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = -0.4, size = 2.6, fontface = "bold") +
    geom_text(data = n_lab, aes(x = CT, y = 0, label = n, color = condition, group = condition),
              position = dodge, angle = 90, hjust = -0.15, size = 2.2, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cond_colors, name = "Condition") +
    scale_color_manual(values = cond_colors, guide = "none") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max_y * (1.1 + 0.06 * nrow(p_lab))), clip = "off") +
    labs(x = "Variant location", y = BETA_LAB,
         title = "Effect size by location (all variant types pooled)", subtitle = set_name) +
    es_theme
}

plot_es_condition <- function(es, set_name) {
  kw <- format.pval(kruskal.test(abs_beta ~ condition, data = es)$p.value, digits = 2)
  pw <- pairwise.wilcox.test(es$abs_beta, es$condition, p.adjust.method = "BH")
  cat("Pairwise Wilcoxon (BH):\n"); print(signif(pw$p.value, 3))
  st <- es %>% group_by(condition) %>%
    summarise(median_es = median(abs_beta), mean_es = mean(abs_beta), n = n(), .groups = "drop")
  print(st)
  ggplot(es, aes(condition, abs_beta, fill = condition)) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6, scale = "width", width = 0.65, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, fill = "white", outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.3, coef = 0) +
    geom_text(data = st, aes(y = 0, label = paste0("n=", n)), vjust = 1.5, size = 2.8, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cond_colors, guide = "none") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.1))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = BETA_LAB,
         title = "Effect size across conditions (all variants pooled)",
         subtitle = paste0(set_name, " | Kruskal-Wallis p = ", kw)) +
    pub_theme() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
}
```

```{r local-distant-numbers}
cat("Local/distant counts by variant type and condition:\n")
print(with(combined_all, table(Genetic_variants, CT, condition)))

cat("\n=== LOCAL vs DISTANT EFFECT SIZE (one-sided Wilcoxon, local > distant) ===\n")
for (cond in unique(combined_all$condition)) {
  d <- combined_all %>% filter(condition == cond, CT %in% c("Local", "Distant"))
  local_es <- d$abs_beta[d$CT == "Local"]; distant_es <- d$abs_beta[d$CT == "Distant"]
  if (length(local_es) < 3) { cat(sprintf("%s: fewer than 3 local eQTLs, skipped\n", cond)); next }
  w <- wilcox.test(local_es, distant_es, alternative = "greater")
  cat(sprintf("%-20s local n=%3d median=%.3f | distant n=%4d median=%.3f | p = %.2e\n",
              cond, length(local_es), median(local_es), length(distant_es), median(distant_es), w$p.value))
}
```

# 6–10. Stress vs baseline, one fluconazole dose and one baseline at a time

Flu.1 (16 ug/ml) and Flu.2 (8 ug/ml) are different doses, so they are not merged. Each dose
is compared with three baselines, always named in full: **YPD.1**, **YPD (integrated)**
(YPD.1 + YPD.2) and **SC2Glu (integrated)** (sc2glu.1 + sc2glu.2). For every dose x baseline
pair: SNP-gene pair overlap (Venn), eGene overlap (Fisher), effect-size concordance of shared
clumped eQTLs and GO enrichment of baseline-only, shared and fluconazole-only eGenes. Sharing
by variant type and dose-specific eQTLs use one YPD baseline plus SC2Glu (integrated), and are
drawn once with YPD.1 and once with YPD (integrated).

Here eQTLs are the clumped, annotated eQTLs (Step1 tables), and "shared" means the same
variant-gene pair is significant in both datasets.

```{r baseline-objects}
BASELINES <- c("YPD.1", "YPD_integrated", "sc2glu_integrated")
YPD_BASELINES <- c("YPD.1", "YPD_integrated")
FLU_DOSES <- c("Flu.1", "Flu.2")   # 16 ug/ml, 8 ug/ml
file_lab  <- c(YPD.1 = "YPD.1", YPD.2 = "YPD.2", YPD_integrated = "YPD_integrated",
               sc2glu.2 = "SC2Glu.2", sc2glu_integrated = "SC2Glu_integrated",
               Flu.1 = "Flu.1_16ug", Flu.2 = "Flu.2_8ug", scgal.1 = "SCGal.1")

genes_of <- function(k) unique(clumped[[k]]$Pheno)
pairs_of <- function(k) unique(paste(clumped[[k]]$SNP, clumped[[k]]$Pheno, sep = "_"))

total_genes_ref <- read.csv("/scratch/aa9679/SingleCell_cerevisiae/Gene_exp_analysis/yeast_custom_annotations.csv") %>%
  filter(gene_biotype == "protein_coding") %>% pull(gene_id) %>% unique() %>% length()
tested_universe <- read.csv("/scratch/aa9679/SingleCell_cerevisiae/Gene_exp_analysis/yeast_custom_annotations.csv") %>%
  filter(gene_biotype == "protein_coding") %>% pull(gene_id) %>% unique()

run_fisher_pair <- function(setA, setB, nameA, nameB, total) {
  overlap <- intersect(setA, setB)
  mat <- matrix(c(length(overlap), length(setdiff(setA, setB)),
                  length(setdiff(setB, setA)), total - length(union(setA, setB))), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
  res <- fisher.test(mat)
  cat(sprintf("%s vs %s: overlap=%d  OR=%.2f  p=%.3g\n\n", nameA, nameB, length(overlap), res$estimate, res$p.value))
  tibble(A = nameA, B = nameB, n_A = length(setA), n_B = length(setB), overlap = length(overlap),
         odds_ratio = unname(res$estimate), p = res$p.value)
}

run_enrichGO <- function(gene_list, label, universe, ontology = "ALL") {
  g <- intersect(gene_list, universe)
  cat("\n", label, "| genes in universe:", length(g), "\n")
  if (length(g) < 10) { cat("  too few genes (<10), skipping\n"); return(NULL) }
  res <- enrichGO(gene = g, universe = universe, OrgDb = org.Sc.sgd.db, keyType = "ORF",
                  ont = ontology, pAdjustMethod = "BH", pvalueCutoff = 0.05, qvalueCutoff = 0.1)
  if (is.null(res) || nrow(res) == 0) { cat("  no significant terms\n"); return(NULL) }
  cat("  significant terms:", nrow(res), "\n"); res
}

plot_go_pair <- function(go_lists, title, outfile) {
  cat("\n===", title, "=== eGene group sizes:\n"); print(sapply(go_lists, length))
  go_res <- lapply(names(go_lists), function(g) run_enrichGO(go_lists[[g]], g, tested_universe)) %>%
    setNames(names(go_lists))
  go_res <- go_res[!sapply(go_res, is.null)]
  if (length(go_res) == 0) {
    cat("  No group has significant GO terms — no dotplot.\n"); return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  cg <- merge_result(go_res)
  cg@compareClusterResult$Cluster <- factor(cg@compareClusterResult$Cluster, levels = names(go_lists))
  cg@compareClusterResult$Description <- stringr::str_wrap(cg@compareClusterResult$Description, width = 60)
  p <- dotplot(cg, showCategory = 10) + ggtitle(title) + theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 15, margin = margin(b = 10)),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8.5, color = "black", lineheight = 0.85),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", color = "black", angle = 30, hjust = 1),
          axis.title.y = element_blank())
  go_terms_table <- lapply(names(go_res), function(cl) {
    df <- as.data.frame(go_res[[cl]]); df$Cluster <- cl
    df %>% select(Cluster, ONTOLOGY, ID, Description, GeneRatio, BgRatio, pvalue, p.adjust, qvalue)
  }) %>% bind_rows()
  write.csv(go_terms_table, file.path(OUT, sub(".tiff", "_GO_terms.csv", outfile)), row.names = FALSE)
  print(p)
  n_terms <- length(unique(p$data$Description))
  ggsave(file.path(OUT, outfile), p, width = 10, height = max(7, 0.42 * n_terms + 2),
         units = "in", dpi = 300, device = "tiff", compression = "lzw", limitsize = FALSE)
  invisible(p)
}

mk <- function(df) df %>% transmute(pair = paste(SNP, Pheno, sep = "_"),
                                    beta = .data[[signed_col]], Genetic_variants)
```

```{r stress-vs-baseline, fig.width=10, fig.height=6, results='asis'}
# One pairwise comparison of dataset A (left / x axis) with dataset B: SNP-gene pair overlap (Venn),
# eGene overlap (Fisher), effect-size concordance of shared clumped eQTLs and GO enrichment of
# A-only, shared and B-only eGenes. Returns the Fisher row and the concordance row.
compare_pair <- function(ak, bk) {
  a_lab <- lab_of[[ak]]; b_lab <- lab_of[[bk]]
  tag   <- paste0(file_lab[[ak]], "_vs_", file_lab[[bk]])
  cat("\n\n## ", a_lab, " vs ", b_lab, "\n\n", sep = "")
  g_a <- genes_of(ak); g_b <- genes_of(bk)
  p_a <- pairs_of(ak); p_b <- pairs_of(bk)

  # --- 6. SNP-gene pair overlap (Venn) and eGene overlap (Fisher) ---
  cat("\n\n### SNP-gene pair overlap\n\n")
  cat(a_lab, "-", b_lab, "shared:", length(intersect(p_a, p_b)),
      "|", a_lab, "only:", length(setdiff(p_a, p_b)),
      "|", b_lab, "only:", length(setdiff(p_b, p_a)), "\n\n")
  p_venn <- ggvenn(setNames(list(p_a, p_b), c(a_lab, b_lab)),
                   fill_color = unname(c(cond_colors[[a_lab]], cond_colors[[b_lab]])),
                   set_name_size = 5, text_size = 4.5, show_percentage = FALSE) +
    ggtitle(paste("eQTLs (SNP-gene pairs):", a_lab, "vs", b_lab)) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14))
  print(p_venn)
  ggsave(file.path(OUT, paste0("fig_venn_", tag, ".tiff")), p_venn, width = 6.5, height = 6,
         dpi = 600, units = "in", device = "tiff", compression = "lzw")

  cat("\n\n### eGene overlap (Fisher)\n\n")
  fisher <- run_fisher_pair(g_a, g_b, a_lab, b_lab, total_genes_ref)

  # --- 8. effect-size concordance of shared clumped eQTLs ---
  cat("\n\n### Effect-size concordance of shared clumped eQTLs\n\n")
  shared_beta <- inner_join(mk(clumped[[ak]]), mk(clumped[[bk]]), by = c("pair", "Genetic_variants"),
                            suffix = c("_a", "_b")) %>%
    mutate(sign_flip = sign(beta_a) != sign(beta_b))
  cs <- shared_beta %>% summarise(n_shared = n(), n_sign_flip = sum(sign_flip),
                                  pct_flip = round(100 * mean(sign_flip), 1),
                                  pearson_r = if (n() > 2) round(cor(beta_a, beta_b), 3) else NA_real_)
  conc <- cs %>% mutate(dataset_A = a_lab, dataset_B = b_lab, .before = 1)
  print(knitr::kable(conc))
  figB <- ggplot(shared_beta, aes(beta_a, beta_b, color = sign_flip)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, color = "grey70") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, color = "grey70") +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.8) +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.08, vjust = 1.2, size = 3.6, fontface = "bold",
             label = sprintf("n = %d, r = %s\nsign flips = %d (%.1f%%)", cs$n_shared,
                             format(cs$pearson_r), cs$n_sign_flip, cs$pct_flip)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#455A64", "TRUE" = "#C41E3A"),
                       labels = c("FALSE" = "Same direction", "TRUE" = "Sign flip"), name = NULL) +
    labs(x = stringr::str_wrap(paste0("Effect size \u03b2, ", a_lab), 35), y = stringr::str_wrap(paste0("Effect size \u03b2, ", b_lab), 35),
         title = stringr::str_wrap(paste("eQTLs significant in both:", a_lab, "and", b_lab), 45)) +
    pub_theme(theme_classic) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
  print(figB)
  ggsave(file.path(OUT, paste0("figB_effect_concordance_", tag, ".tiff")), figB,
         width = 6.5, height = 5.5, dpi = 600, units = "in", device = "tiff", compression = "lzw")

  # --- 9. GO enrichment: A-only, shared and B-only eGenes ---
  cat("\n\n### GO enrichment\n\n")
  plot_go_pair(setNames(list(setdiff(g_a, g_b), intersect(g_a, g_b), setdiff(g_b, g_a)),
                        c(paste0(a_lab, "-only"), paste0("Shared ", a_lab, " & ", b_lab), paste0(b_lab, "-only"))),
               paste("GO enrichment:", a_lab, "vs", b_lab), paste0("GO_comparison_", tag, ".tiff"))
  list(fisher = fisher, conc = conc)
}

fisher_all <- list(); conc_all <- list()
for (fk in FLU_DOSES) for (bk in BASELINES) {
  r <- compare_pair(bk, fk)
  fisher_all[[length(fisher_all) + 1]] <- r$fisher
  conc_all[[length(conc_all) + 1]] <- r$conc %>% dplyr::rename(baseline = dataset_A, fluconazole = dataset_B)
}
fisher_all <- bind_rows(fisher_all); conc_all <- bind_rows(conc_all)
write.csv(fisher_all, file.path(OUT, "eGene_overlap_Fisher_baselines_vs_Flu.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(conc_all, file.path(OUT, "Shared_eQTL_concordance_baselines_vs_Flu.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(fisher_all, digits = 3); knitr::kable(conc_all)
```

## 7, 10. Sharing by variant type and dose-specific eQTLs

Three-way sharing of each fluconazole dose with one YPD baseline and SC2Glu (integrated);
drawn once with YPD.1 and once with YPD (integrated).

```{r sharing-and-specific, fig.width=7, fig.height=5, results='asis'}
specific <- list()
for (yk in YPD_BASELINES) for (fk in FLU_DOSES) {
  ypd_lab <- lab_of[[yk]]; flu_lab <- lab_of[[fk]]; sg_lab <- lab_of[["sc2glu_integrated"]]
  tag <- paste0(file_lab[[yk]], "_SC2Glu_integrated_", file_lab[[fk]])
  cat("\n\n### ", ypd_lab, ", ", sg_lab, ", ", flu_lab, "\n\n", sep = "")

  share_prop <- bind_rows(clumped[[yk]] %>% mutate(condition = ypd_lab),
                          clumped[["sc2glu_integrated"]] %>% mutate(condition = sg_lab),
                          clumped[[fk]] %>% mutate(condition = flu_lab)) %>%
    mutate(pair = paste(SNP, Pheno, sep = "_")) %>%
    distinct(pair, condition, Genetic_variants) %>%
    group_by(pair, Genetic_variants) %>%
    summarise(n_cond = n_distinct(condition), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(sharing = case_when(n_cond == 3 ~ "All three", n_cond == 2 ~ "Two conditions",
                               TRUE ~ "Condition-specific")) %>%
    count(Genetic_variants, sharing) %>%
    group_by(Genetic_variants) %>% mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>% ungroup() %>%
    mutate(sharing = factor(sharing, levels = c("Condition-specific", "Two conditions", "All three")),
           Genetic_variants = factor(Genetic_variants, levels = variant_levels))
  figA <- ggplot(share_prop, aes(Genetic_variants, prop, fill = sharing)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(prop > 0.04, percent(prop, 1), "")),
              position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3.2, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Condition-specific" = "#B0BEC5", "Two conditions" = "#FFB74D",
                                 "All three" = "#455A64"), name = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Fraction of eQTLs", title = "Condition-sharing of eQTLs by variant type",
         subtitle = paste(ypd_lab, sg_lab, flu_lab, sep = ", ")) +
    pub_theme(theme_classic) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
  print(figA)
  ggsave(file.path(OUT, paste0("figA_sharing_by_variant_type_", tag, ".tiff")), figA,
         width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 600, units = "in", device = "tiff", compression = "lzw")

  # dose-specific eQTLs: not significant in this YPD baseline nor in SC2Glu (integrated)
  base_pairs <- union(pairs_of(yk), pairs_of("sc2glu_integrated"))
  base_genes <- union(genes_of(yk), genes_of("sc2glu_integrated"))
  flu_specific <- clumped[[fk]] %>% filter(!paste(SNP, Pheno, sep = "_") %in% base_pairs)
  specific[[tag]] <- tibble(YPD_baseline = ypd_lab, fluconazole = flu_lab,
                            specific_pairs = nrow(flu_specific),
                            specific_variant_baseline_eGene = n_distinct(flu_specific$Pheno[flu_specific$Pheno %in% base_genes]),
                            fully_novel_eGenes = n_distinct(flu_specific$Pheno[!flu_specific$Pheno %in% base_genes]))
  print(knitr::kable(specific[[tag]]))
  write.csv(flu_specific, file.path(OUT, paste0(file_lab[[fk]], "_specific_eQTLs_vs_", file_lab[[yk]], "_and_SC2Glu_integrated.csv")),
            row.names = FALSE)
}
specific <- bind_rows(specific)
write.csv(specific, file.path(OUT, "Flu_specific_eQTL_counts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# eQTLs specific to fluconazole at BOTH doses
for (yk in YPD_BASELINES) {
  base_pairs <- union(pairs_of(yk), pairs_of("sc2glu_integrated"))
  spec <- lapply(setNames(FLU_DOSES, FLU_DOSES), function(fk) setdiff(pairs_of(fk), base_pairs))
  both <- intersect(spec[["Flu.1"]], spec[["Flu.2"]])
  cat("\nAbsent from", lab_of[[yk]], "and SC2Glu (integrated): 16 ug/ml =", length(spec[["Flu.1"]]),
      "| 8 ug/ml =", length(spec[["Flu.2"]]), "| both doses =", length(both), "\n")
  write.csv(data.frame(pair = both), file.path(OUT, paste0("Flu_specific_eQTLs_both_doses_vs_", file_lab[[yk]], "_and_SC2Glu_integrated.csv")),
            row.names = FALSE)
}
```

# 12. Galactose (scgal.1) vs fluconazole and baselines

The same pairwise comparison as Sections 6, 8 and 9 (SNP-gene pair overlap, eGene overlap,
effect-size concordance of shared eQTLs and GO enrichment of A-only, shared and B-only eGenes)
for galactose against each fluconazole dose, and each baseline against galactose. Galactose is
dataset A against fluconazole and dataset B against the baselines.

```{r galactose-comparisons, fig.width=10, fig.height=6, results='asis'}
GAL_PAIRS <- list(c("scgal.1", "Flu.1"), c("scgal.1", "Flu.2"),
                  c("YPD.1", "scgal.1"), c("YPD.2", "scgal.1"), c("YPD_integrated", "scgal.1"),
                  c("sc2glu.2", "scgal.1"), c("sc2glu_integrated", "scgal.1"))
gal_res <- lapply(GAL_PAIRS, function(pr) compare_pair(pr[1], pr[2]))
gal_fisher <- bind_rows(lapply(gal_res, `[[`, "fisher"))
gal_conc   <- bind_rows(lapply(gal_res, `[[`, "conc"))
write.csv(gal_fisher, file.path(OUT, "eGene_overlap_Fisher_galactose_comparisons.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(gal_conc, file.path(OUT, "Shared_eQTL_concordance_galactose_comparisons.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(gal_fisher, digits = 3); knitr::kable(gal_conc)
```

# 13. Combined summary table (datasets reported in the paper)

One table for the manuscript with the six datasets reported in the paper side by side: YPD.1,
YPD.2, synthetic complete (sc2glu.2), fluconazole 16 and 8 ug/ml and galactose. sc2glu.1 and the
integrated datasets stay in the rest of this report but are not in the table. Counts are descriptive only: datasets differ in strains, cells and expression variance,
so they are not compared between datasets (between-condition comparisons are done with mashr).
Columns per dataset and variant type:

- `tested_variants`: variants tested (Step1 `variant_summary_stats.txt`, from the .bim files)
- `eQTL_variants`: unique lead variants of the per-gene clumps; `eQTLs`: variant-gene pairs;
  `eGenes`: genes with >= 1 eQTL
- `local`, `distant`, `pct_distant`: local = any clump variant within 25 kb of the gene
- `median_abs_beta*`: median |beta| (all, local, distant eQTLs)
- `odds_ratio`, `odds_ratio_FDR`: odds of a variant of this type being an eQTL vs all other types
  (Fisher's exact test, Step1 `odds_ratio_enrichment.txt`)
- `mean_genes_per_eQTL_variant`, `median_genes_per_eQTL_variant`: pleiotropy

The second table holds the within-dataset tests: local vs distant |beta| (two-sided Wilcoxon),
|beta| across variant types and pleiotropy across variant types (Kruskal-Wallis), and the order of
variant types by median |beta| and by mean pleiotropy.

```{r combined-summary-table}
TABLE_KEYS <- c("YPD.1", "YPD.2", "sc2glu.2", "Flu.1", "Flu.2", "scgal.1")
summ_dir <- function(annot) sub("annotations$", "eqtl_plot/data_summary", annot)
vt_step1 <- c("SNPs" = "SNPs", "InDels" = "InDels", "SVs" = "SVs", "Gene-based CNVs" = "CNVs")

summarise_eqtls <- function(d) d %>% summarise(
  eQTL_variants  = n_distinct(SNP),
  eQTLs          = n(),
  eGenes         = n_distinct(Pheno),
  local          = sum(CT == "Local", na.rm = TRUE),
  distant        = sum(CT == "Distant", na.rm = TRUE),
  pct_distant    = round(100 * distant / (local + distant), 1),
  median_abs_beta         = median(abs_beta, na.rm = TRUE),
  median_abs_beta_local   = median(abs_beta[CT == "Local"], na.rm = TRUE),
  median_abs_beta_distant = median(abs_beta[CT == "Distant"], na.rm = TRUE),
  .groups = "drop")

combined_table <- bind_rows(lapply(TABLE_KEYS, function(k) {
  d  <- clumped[[k]] %>% mutate(CT = local_distant, abs_beta = abs(SnpWeight))
  sd <- summ_dir(COND$annot[COND$key == k])
  vs <- fread(file.path(sd, "variant_summary_stats.txt"), data.table = FALSE) %>%
    transmute(Genetic_variants = vt_step1[variant_type], tested_variants = total_count)
  or <- fread(file.path(sd, "odds_ratio_enrichment.txt"), data.table = FALSE) %>%
    transmute(Genetic_variants = vt_step1[VariantType], odds_ratio = OddsRatio, odds_ratio_FDR = PValue_FDR)
  pl <- d %>% group_by(Genetic_variants, SNP) %>% summarise(n_genes = n_distinct(Pheno), .groups = "drop")
  by_type <- d %>% group_by(Genetic_variants) %>% summarise_eqtls() %>%
    left_join(vs, by = "Genetic_variants") %>% left_join(or, by = "Genetic_variants") %>%
    left_join(pl %>% group_by(Genetic_variants) %>%
                summarise(mean_genes_per_eQTL_variant = mean(n_genes),
                          median_genes_per_eQTL_variant = median(n_genes)), by = "Genetic_variants")
  by_type %>%
    mutate(dataset = lab_of[[k]], key = k,
           n_strains = pheno_strain_summary$n_strains[pheno_strain_summary$key == k],
           n_genes_tested = pheno_strain_summary$n_phenotypes[pheno_strain_summary$key == k])
})) %>%
  mutate(Genetic_variants = factor(Genetic_variants, levels = variant_levels),
         dataset = factor(dataset, levels = lab_of[TABLE_KEYS])) %>%
  arrange(dataset, Genetic_variants) %>%
  select(dataset, key, n_strains, n_genes_tested, Genetic_variants, tested_variants, eQTL_variants,
         eQTLs, eGenes, local, distant, pct_distant, median_abs_beta, median_abs_beta_local,
         median_abs_beta_distant, odds_ratio, odds_ratio_FDR, mean_genes_per_eQTL_variant,
         median_genes_per_eQTL_variant) %>%
  mutate(Genetic_variants = recode(as.character(Genetic_variants), CNVs = "Gene-based CNVs"))
write.csv(combined_table, file.path(OUT, "combined_eQTL_summary_all_datasets.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# wide version: one row per variant type x metric, one column per dataset
combined_wide <- combined_table %>% select(-key, -n_strains, -n_genes_tested) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3))) %>%
  mutate(across(-c(dataset, Genetic_variants), as.character)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(dataset, Genetic_variants), names_to = "metric") %>%
  mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = unique(metric))) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = dataset, values_from = value) %>%
  arrange(factor(Genetic_variants, levels = c("SNPs", "InDels", "SVs", "Gene-based CNVs")), metric)
write.csv(combined_wide, file.path(OUT, "combined_eQTL_summary_all_datasets_wide.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# within-dataset tests
within_tests <- bind_rows(lapply(TABLE_KEYS, function(k) {
  d  <- clumped[[k]] %>% mutate(CT = local_distant, abs_beta = abs(SnpWeight)) %>% filter(!is.na(abs_beta))
  pl <- d %>% group_by(Genetic_variants, SNP) %>% summarise(n_genes = n_distinct(Pheno), .groups = "drop")
  med_es <- d %>% group_by(Genetic_variants) %>% summarise(m = median(abs_beta)) %>% arrange(desc(m))
  mean_pl <- pl %>% group_by(Genetic_variants) %>% summarise(m = mean(n_genes)) %>% arrange(desc(m))
  tibble(dataset = lab_of[[k]],
         p_local_vs_distant_abs_beta = if (sum(d$CT == "Local") >= 3) wilcox.test(abs_beta ~ CT, data = d)$p.value else NA_real_,
         local_larger_abs_beta = median(d$abs_beta[d$CT == "Local"]) > median(d$abs_beta[d$CT == "Distant"]),
         p_abs_beta_across_types = kruskal.test(abs_beta ~ Genetic_variants, data = d)$p.value,
         order_by_median_abs_beta = paste(recode(med_es$Genetic_variants, CNVs = "Gene-based CNVs"), collapse = " > "),
         p_pleiotropy_across_types = kruskal.test(n_genes ~ factor(Genetic_variants), data = pl)$p.value,
         order_by_mean_pleiotropy = paste(recode(mean_pl$Genetic_variants, CNVs = "Gene-based CNVs"), collapse = " > "))
}))
write.csv(within_tests, file.path(OUT, "combined_eQTL_within_dataset_tests.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

knitr::kable(combined_wide)
knitr::kable(within_tests, digits = 4)
```

## Pleiotropy by variant type in each dataset

Number of genes associated with each unique eQTL variant (lead variant of a per-gene clump),
by variant type, one panel per dataset. Boxes: median and IQR; black diamond: mean. Labels:
pairwise Wilcoxon rank-sum test of SVs against each other variant type, BH-adjusted over all six
pairs within the dataset (all pairs are in `pleiotropy_pairwise_wilcoxon_six_datasets.csv`).

```{r pleiotropy-six-datasets, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
pleio_vt_colors <- c("SNPs" = "#4472C4", "InDels" = "#FFC000", "SVs" = "#C41E3A", "Gene-based CNVs" = "#70AD47")
pleio_vt_levels <- c("SNPs", "InDels", "Gene-based CNVs", "SVs")
# p-value label for one value per panel (p below the double-precision limit is shown as < 1e-300)
p_text <- function(p) ifelse(p == 0, "p < 1e-300", paste0("p = ", sapply(p, format, digits = 2)))
pleio_ds_lab <- lab_of[TABLE_KEYS]
pleio6 <- bind_rows(lapply(TABLE_KEYS, function(k) clumped[[k]] %>%
    group_by(Genetic_variants, SNP) %>% summarise(n_genes = n_distinct(Pheno), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(dataset = pleio_ds_lab[[k]]))) %>%
  mutate(Genetic_variants = factor(recode(Genetic_variants, CNVs = "Gene-based CNVs"), levels = pleio_vt_levels),
         dataset = factor(dataset, levels = pleio_ds_lab))

pleio_pw <- pleio6 %>% group_by(dataset) %>% group_modify(function(d, ...) {
  pr <- combn(pleio_vt_levels, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  tibble(type_1 = sapply(pr, `[`, 1), type_2 = sapply(pr, `[`, 2),
         p = sapply(pr, function(x) wilcox.test(d$n_genes[d$Genetic_variants == x[1]],
                                                d$n_genes[d$Genetic_variants == x[2]])$p.value)) %>%
    mutate(p_BH = p.adjust(p, "BH"))
}) %>% ungroup()
write.csv(pleio_pw, file.path(OUT, "pleiotropy_pairwise_wilcoxon_six_datasets.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

sv_lab <- pleio_pw %>% filter(type_2 == "SVs") %>%
  transmute(dataset, Genetic_variants = factor(type_1, levels = pleio_vt_levels),
            label = paste0("vs SVs\n", p_text(p_BH)))
pleio_means <- pleio6 %>% group_by(dataset, Genetic_variants) %>%
  summarise(mean_genes = mean(n_genes), n = n(), .groups = "drop")

fig_pleio6 <- ggplot(pleio6, aes(Genetic_variants, n_genes, fill = Genetic_variants)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.3, outlier.size = 0.8, width = 0.6) +
  geom_point(data = pleio_means, aes(y = mean_genes), shape = 23, size = 3, fill = "black") +
  geom_text(data = sv_lab, aes(y = Inf, label = label), vjust = 1.2, size = 3.3, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_text(data = pleio_means, aes(y = 0.8, label = paste0("n=", n)), size = 3.2, fontface = "bold") +
  facet_wrap(~ dataset, nrow = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pleio_vt_colors) +
  scale_y_log10(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.3))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Genes per eQTL variant (log scale)",
       title = "Pleiotropy of eQTL variants by variant type") +
  pub_theme(theme_classic) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
print(fig_pleio6)
ggsave(file.path(OUT, "fig_pleiotropy_by_variant_type_six_datasets.tiff"), fig_pleio6,
       width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 600, units = "in", device = "tiff", compression = "lzw")
ggsave(file.path(OUT, "fig_pleiotropy_by_variant_type_six_datasets.png"), fig_pleio6,
       width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300, units = "in")
knitr::kable(pleio_pw %>% mutate(across(c(p, p_BH), ~ signif(.x, 3))))
```

## Effect size by variant type in each dataset

Absolute effect size (|beta|) of the eQTLs (variant-gene pairs after per-gene clumping) by variant
type, one panel per dataset; effect sizes are compared only within a dataset. Boxes: median and
IQR; black diamond: mean. Labels: pairwise Wilcoxon rank-sum test of SNPs against each other
variant type, BH-adjusted over all six pairs within the dataset (all pairs are in
`effect_size_pairwise_wilcoxon_six_datasets.csv`).

```{r effect-size-six-datasets, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
# Wilcoxon rank-sum p-value, normal approximation with tie and continuity correction. R 4.6.1
# wilcox.test() returns p = 0 for these comparisons (also with exact = FALSE), although z is ~16
# (p ~ 1e-58), so the p-value is computed here.
wilcox_p <- function(x, y) {
  n1 <- length(x); n2 <- length(y); r <- rank(c(x, y))
  W <- sum(r[seq_len(n1)]) - n1 * (n1 + 1) / 2
  ties <- table(r)
  sigma <- sqrt(n1 * n2 / 12 * ((n1 + n2 + 1) - sum(ties^3 - ties) / ((n1 + n2) * (n1 + n2 - 1))))
  z <- (W - n1 * n2 / 2 - sign(W - n1 * n2 / 2) * 0.5) / sigma
  2 * pnorm(-abs(z))
}

es6 <- bind_rows(lapply(TABLE_KEYS, function(k) clumped[[k]] %>%
    transmute(Genetic_variants, abs_beta = abs(SnpWeight), dataset = pleio_ds_lab[[k]]))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(abs_beta)) %>%
  mutate(Genetic_variants = factor(recode(Genetic_variants, CNVs = "Gene-based CNVs"), levels = pleio_vt_levels),
         dataset = factor(dataset, levels = pleio_ds_lab))

es_pw <- es6 %>% group_by(dataset) %>% group_modify(function(d, ...) {
  pr <- combn(pleio_vt_levels, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  tibble(type_1 = sapply(pr, `[`, 1), type_2 = sapply(pr, `[`, 2),
         p = sapply(pr, function(x) wilcox_p(d$abs_beta[d$Genetic_variants == x[1]],
                                             d$abs_beta[d$Genetic_variants == x[2]]))) %>%
    mutate(p_BH = p.adjust(p, "BH"))
}) %>% ungroup()
write.csv(es_pw, file.path(OUT, "effect_size_pairwise_wilcoxon_six_datasets.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

snp_lab <- es_pw %>% filter(type_1 == "SNPs") %>%
  transmute(dataset, Genetic_variants = factor(type_2, levels = pleio_vt_levels),
            label = paste0("vs SNPs\n", p_text(p_BH)))
es_means <- es6 %>% group_by(dataset, Genetic_variants) %>%
  summarise(mean_abs_beta = mean(abs_beta), n = n(), .groups = "drop")

fig_es6 <- ggplot(es6, aes(Genetic_variants, abs_beta, fill = Genetic_variants)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.3, outlier.size = 0.8, width = 0.6) +
  geom_point(data = es_means, aes(y = mean_abs_beta), shape = 23, size = 3, fill = "black") +
  geom_text(data = snp_lab, aes(y = Inf, label = label), vjust = 1.2, size = 3.3, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_text(data = es_means, aes(y = 0, label = paste0("n=", n)), vjust = 1.3, size = 3.2, fontface = "bold") +
  facet_wrap(~ dataset, nrow = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pleio_vt_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.3))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = BETA_LAB, title = "eQTL effect size by variant type") +
  pub_theme(theme_classic) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
print(fig_es6)
ggsave(file.path(OUT, "fig_effect_size_by_variant_type_six_datasets.tiff"), fig_es6,
       width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 600, units = "in", device = "tiff", compression = "lzw")
ggsave(file.path(OUT, "fig_effect_size_by_variant_type_six_datasets.png"), fig_es6,
       width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300, units = "in")
knitr::kable(es_pw %>% mutate(across(c(p, p_BH), ~ signif(.x, 3))))
```

## Effect size by location in each dataset

Same layout as the variant-type figure above: absolute effect size (|beta|) of local and distant
eQTLs (all variant types pooled), one panel per dataset. Boxes: median and IQR; black diamond:
mean. Label: Wilcoxon rank-sum test of local vs distant within the dataset (one test per dataset,
in `effect_size_local_vs_distant_six_datasets.csv`). Colours as in Figure 3 (local blue, distant orange).

```{r effect-size-location-six-datasets, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
loc_levels <- c("Local", "Distant")
loc_colors <- c("Local" = "#1F77B4", "Distant" = "#FF7F0E")

es6_loc <- bind_rows(lapply(TABLE_KEYS, function(k) clumped[[k]] %>%
    transmute(location = local_distant, abs_beta = abs(SnpWeight), dataset = pleio_ds_lab[[k]]))) %>%
  filter(location %in% loc_levels, !is.na(abs_beta)) %>%
  mutate(location = factor(location, levels = loc_levels),
         dataset = factor(dataset, levels = pleio_ds_lab))

es_loc_test <- es6_loc %>% group_by(dataset) %>%

write.csv(es_loc_test, file.path(OUT, "effect_size_local_vs_distant_six_datasets.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

loc_lab <- es_loc_test %>% transmute(dataset, label = paste0("Local vs distant\n", p_text(p)))
es_loc_means <- es6_loc %>% group_by(dataset, location) %>%

fig_es6_loc <- ggplot(es6_loc, aes(location, abs_beta, fill = location)) +

  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.3))) +

print(fig_es6_loc)
ggsave(file.path(OUT, "fig_effect_size_by_location_six_datasets.tiff"), fig_es6_loc,
       width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 600, units = "in", device = "tiff", compression = "lzw")
ggsave(file.path(OUT, "fig_effect_size_by_location_six_datasets.png"), fig_es6_loc,
       width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300, units = "in")
knitr::kable(es_loc_test %>% mutate(across(c(median_local, median_distant), ~ round(.x, 3)),
```

## eQTL enrichment by variant type in each dataset

Odds of a tested variant of each type being an eQTL, against all other variant types together
(Fisher's exact test, BH-adjusted over the four types; Step1 `odds_ratio_enrichment.txt`), one
panel per dataset. Bars: log2 odds ratio (> 0 enriched, < 0 depleted); labels: odds ratio and
adjusted p. The background of each comparison is mostly SNPs (about 89% of tested variants).

```{r odds-ratio-six-datasets, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
or6 <- combined_table %>%
  transmute(dataset = factor(pleio_ds_lab[key], levels = pleio_ds_lab),
            Genetic_variants = factor(Genetic_variants, levels = pleio_vt_levels),
            odds_ratio, odds_ratio_FDR, log2OR = log2(odds_ratio),
            label = paste0("OR = ", signif(odds_ratio, 2), "\n", p_text(odds_ratio_FDR)))

fig_or6 <- ggplot(or6, aes(Genetic_variants, log2OR, fill = Genetic_variants)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label, vjust = ifelse(log2OR >= 0, -0.25, 1.15)), size = 3.2, fontface = "bold") +
  facet_wrap(~ dataset, nrow = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pleio_vt_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.3, 0.3))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "log2 odds ratio (eQTL vs other variant types)",
       title = "Enrichment of variant types among eQTLs") +

  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
print(fig_or6)
ggsave(file.path(OUT, "fig_odds_ratio_by_variant_type_six_datasets.tiff"), fig_or6,
       width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 600, units = "in", device = "tiff", compression = "lzw")
ggsave(file.path(OUT, "fig_odds_ratio_by_variant_type_six_datasets.png"), fig_or6,
```

# 14. Dataset overview table

One row per dataset reported in the paper: the experimental scale (strains, cells, sequencing
depth), the between-strain expression variance and the eQTLs detected. It shows that eQTL counts
follow the scale of each experiment (the two YPD replicates, same medium, already differ), so
counts are not compared between conditions.

- `strains`, `cells`, `median_cells_per_strain`, `median_UMI_per_cell`: filtered single-cell
  objects used for the pseudobulks (`Na_va_data_subsetted.rds`), from the mashr report cache
  `../results/mashr/dataset_qc.rds`
- `genes_tested`: genes in the FaST-LMM gene matrix
- `median_expression_variance`: median over genes of the between-strain variance of the
  pseudobulk expression, on the genes and strains shared by all six datasets (Section 2)
- `eQTLs`: variant-gene pairs after per-gene clumping; `eGenes`: genes with >= 1 eQTL

```{r dataset-overview-table}
qc_cells <- readRDS("../results/mashr/dataset_qc.rds") %>%
  mutate(key = recode(dataset, Flu_16ug = "Flu.1", Flu_8ug = "Flu.2", galactose = "scgal.1")) %>%
  select(key, strains, cells, median_cells_per_strain, median_UMI_per_cell)
vs6 <- variance_set(TABLE_KEYS)
overview_names <- c(YPD.1 = "YPD.1", YPD.2 = "YPD.2", sc2glu.2 = "synthetic complete with glucose",
                    Flu.1 = "fluconazole 16 ug/ml", Flu.2 = "fluconazole 8 ug/ml", scgal.1 = "synthetic complete with galactose")

dataset_overview <- tibble(key = TABLE_KEYS) %>%
  left_join(qc_cells, by = "key") %>%
  mutate(dataset = unname(overview_names[key]),
         genes_tested = sapply(key, function(k) nrow(mats[[k]])),
         median_expression_variance = round(unname(apply(vs6$wide, 2, median, na.rm = TRUE)[set_lab(key)]), 1),
         eQTLs = sapply(key, function(k) nrow(clumped[[k]])),
         eGenes = sapply(key, function(k) n_distinct(clumped[[k]]$Pheno))) %>%
  select(dataset, strains, cells, median_cells_per_strain, median_UMI_per_cell, genes_tested,
         median_expression_variance, eQTLs, eGenes)
write.csv(dataset_overview, file.path(OUT, "dataset_overview_table.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("Variance on", length(vs6$genes), "genes x", length(vs6$strains), "strains shared by the six datasets\n")
cat("Excluded: sc2glu.1,", ncol(mats[["sc2glu.1"]]), "strains, 1,637 cells (low cell recovery)\n")
```
